bounded_hypothesis: A fresh OmD installation should remain ready, byte-stable, routable, and safely refreshable after more than seven days without requiring the user to rebuild local state.
candidate_delta: Add a day-8 local integration cohort across Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, and Cursor, then repair natural EN and Chinese change verbs exposed by that cohort.
repairs_discovered: English repair was absent from explicit change intent.
Chinese 修改, 改进, and 改進 were absent from explicit change intent.
rollback_gate: Revert if any channel becomes non-ready after aged local state, refresh mutates managed content, or an explicit existing-surface repair request routes to design-system creation.
first_failure_rule: Any channel or locale failure fails the cohort; do not average it away.
claim_boundary: This proves technical day-8 survivability under a time-compressed local integration cohort. It is not a human retention rate, production activation lift, or seven-day behavioral observation.
decision: Close technical reuse survivability. Keep behavioral activation/reuse lift open, but do not require the user to perform a seven-day manual test.
